drafts.text:
Hello AMTC Foodservice Equipment LLC team,

I saw AMTC's announcement that a new website is in progress.

I'm Ramish, founder of Nexora. Its website CMS lets staff manage branded pages, navigation and published content. A focused evaluation could use three sample service and equipment-information pages and one editor to check draft, preview and publication before agreeing a wider website scope.

I've attached a 90-second narrated introduction to Nexora's wider membership platform. A website-editor walkthrough would focus on your content needs.

Would a 15-minute website-editor walkthrough be useful for your service and equipment-information pages?

Best,
Ramish Qureshi
Founder, Nexora
